evidence.title: Agility Robotics CEO Peggy Johnson Selected to Join Project Meridian
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore., Oct. 5, 2026 — Agility Robotics , a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today announced that CEO Peggy Johnson will participate in Project Meridian, a Department of War (DoW)-commissioned initiative bringing together prominent industry executives and former government leaders to examine the future of warfare and inform long-term defense capability development and investment priorities. Led by The MITRE Corporation, Project Meridian will develop strategic recommendations over a 10- to 20-year horizon, exploring emerging technologies, evolving operational concepts and the capabilities needed to address future national security challenges. The initiative brings together leaders from across the defense and technology industries. As a member of the group, Johnson will participate in an individual consultant capacity, drawing on her decades of technology leadership experience and Agility’s expertise in developing and commercially deploying humanoid robots to discussions about how emerging technologies and commercial innovation can support the military's evolving needs. “The future of robotics isn't just about developing new capabilities.
